reader.role: graduate economics student with econometrics training
reader.reading_context: Reads the complete survey without access to the source repository or the authors, deciding which sampler to use for a zero-lower-bound model.

brief.purpose: Understand the four posterior geometries a zero lower bound can induce and which sampling method each one calls for.
brief.decision: Which sampler to use for a given zero-lower-bound model specification.
brief.evidence_boundary: Use only the frozen ZLB manuscript at sources/zlb-benchmark/zlb_source.tex. No external literature may be introduced.

remote_inference.purpose: Concept extraction, source-grounded rewriting, and independent critic verification for the WP-V2-6 ZLB benchmark.

voice_constraints.register: clear technical prose in the third person
additional: No first-person narration of the revision process.
Preserve the survey's expository stance toward the literature.

brief.protected_object_policy: Preserve exact equations, displayed math, citations, labels, cross-references, table content, and all numerals. No protected object may be altered, renumbered, or dropped.
